description: Clone a single-generate-node flow once per candidate model (same prompt/style/references), preflight each, and start sibling runs to compare engines. live charges per sibling and needs a total ceiling.

maxTotalUsdMicros.description: Live only: the most the whole comparison may cost, in USD micros. The sum of the siblings' preflight ceilings must fit or nothing is started.

mode.description: mock = free dry run. live = paid provider generation — confirm with the user first.

models.description: The engines to compare — one sibling session per entry. Discover provider/modelId pairs with list_image_models.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

name: compare_image_models
